quests.title: A bed of two cells
quests.ask: Plant a short bed: the cell the robot stands on and the one in front of it each end with one gem.
quests.nudge: Count the gems you need and the steps you take. Are they the same number?

quests.title: A bed of one cell
quests.ask: The smallest bed: one cell, with the wall right in front. It still needs its gem.
quests.nudge: Which lines still run when the robot can't take a single step?

quests.title: A bed of any length
quests.ask: Now a longer bed. Plant every cell up to the wall with the same program.
quests.nudge: If your program only fits one bed, what does it rely on?
